content.text:
Available namespaces:

  bam: Tools to process sam/bam/cram files
  bed: Tools to handle BED files
  cellranger: Cellranger pipeline module for BioPipen
  cellranger_pipeline: The cellranger pipelines
  cnv: CNV/CNA-related processes, mostly tertiary analysis
  cnvkit: CNVkit commnads
  cnvkit_pipeline: The CNVkit pipeline.
  delim: Tools to deal with csv/tsv files
  gene: Gene related processes
  gsea: Gene set enrichment analysis
  misc: Misc processes
  pipseeker: Pipseeker processes
  plot: Plotting data
  protein: Protein-related processes.
  regulatory: Provides processes for the regulatory related
  rnaseq: RNA-seq data analysis
  scrna: Tools to analyze single-cell RNA
  scrna_metabolic_landscape: Metabolic landscape analysis for scRNA-seq data
  snp: Plink processes
  stats: Provides processes for statistics.
  tcgamaf: Processes for TCGA MAF files.
  tcr: Tools to analyze single-cell TCR sequencing data
  vcf: Tools to handle VCF files
  web: Get data from the web

Use get_processes('<namespace>') to see available processes.
